name: Python Dev container
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y git curl build-essential ripgrep fd-find fzf luarocks && sudo ln -sf /usr/bin/fdfind /usr/local/bin/fd && mkdir -p ~/.local/opt ~/.local/bin && curl -L https://github.com/neovim/neovim/releases/latest/download/nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz -o /tmp/nvim.tar.gz && tar xzf /tmp/nvim.tar.gz -C ~/.local/opt && ln -sf ~/.local/opt/nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim ~/.local/bin/nvim && rm /tmp/nvim.tar.gz && npm install -g tree-sitter-cli && uv sync -q
